scientific_integrity: The all-horizon global minimum is established analytically. Finite numerical tests independently corroborate Fourier identities and optimization but do not serve as exhaustive proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous stay-or-advance transitions on the oriented triangle are optimized; arbitrary three-state kernels and threshold-specific mixing times are excluded. Historical priority remains uncertain for inaccessible cycle-mixing literature.
title: Exact finite-horizon total-variation optimizers for a lazy directed triangle
